description: This file defines functions and types for converting Anthropic messages to an OpenAI-compatible format, specifically optimized for Z.ai's interleaved thinking mode. It handles message content including text, images, tool results, and reasoning content, with special merging logic to preserve reasoning across message exchanges.

classes.name: ZAiAssistantMessage
classes.description: Extended assistant message type to support Z.ai's interleaved thinking, including optional reasoning_content.

methods.name: convertToZAiFormat
methods.description: Converts an array of Anthropic messages into an array of OpenAI messages optimized for Z.ai's interleaved thinking mode, with options to merge tool result text.
